title: Jerninja's Quality Recipes
description: Introducing recipes to make your day better
body:
Minecraft has a lot of wonky recipes and hard to get items in the early game.\
Note: this mod was made with MCreator, my next mods will not be using it.

This mod aims to make some lesser used items usefull by adding Recipes and new items.\
Useless things adds:
- 22 Recipes
- Reworked 6 vanilla recipes 
- 17 Advancements
- 3 Items
- 2 Structures
- 1 biome


Reworked recipes:
- Blast furnaces can now be made with any stone block
- Composters are now 7 planks instead of slabs
- Paper, Sugar and Bread recipes give double the product and are now shapeless
- TNT is now made with 1 gunpowder surrounded by 8 sand (gives 4 TNT)



New recipes like: a recipe for Totems of Undying:\
![Totem of Undying recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ccad0da9666fcfc9bf69e38fc6be094d0f1c0943.png)

or a recipe for Wind Charges:\
![Wind Charge recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/7269674b8fdc681e855d5d3ee1997b7efd26075c.png)

and a recipe for Tridents:\
![Trident Recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/087b3da40780c2a1b6ce39510ae19153912a6704.png)\
this is just the tip of the iceberg
